notes.title: 〚 0.8.9 〛Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
Patch Notes V0.8.9  

🛠 Bug Fixes  
 Fixed Achievement unlock issue for characters.  
 Fixed sound stacking issues.  
 Fixed abnormally high spawn chances for Meditate, War Cry, and Last Stand.  

✨ Improvements  
 Increased revive chance significantly in Multiplayer mode.  
 Improved drop rates from breakable objects.  
 Improved hitbox accuracy for certain projectiles.  

⚔ Character Buffs & Adjustments  

Shara (Archer)  
 Luster Burst Revamp  
 Luster Burst projectile speed multiplier 2x → 1.35x  
 Ammo 7 → 12  
 Projectile speed 20 → 22  
 Evo 1 Pierce Chance 10% → 15%  
 Evo 3 Pierce Chance 20% → 30%  
 Artemis Burst base damage 10 → 15  

Theo (Miner)  
 Attack Speed 0.8 → 1  
 Groundbreaker base damage 10 → 20  
 Groundbreaker cooldown 5s → 3s  

Zane (Knight)  
 Neo Sword Slash combo requirement reduced from 5 → 4 to activate Super Slash.
 Attack Speed 0.7 → 0.8  
 Attack Target 5 → 6  

Zenova (Star Wanderer)  
 Attack Speed 1 → 1.25  
 Movement Speed 2.6 → 2.8  
 Critical Chance 1% → 5%  

⚖ Special Upgrades  
 Assassination Damage 1000% → 1500%, Cooldown 5s → 3s  
 First Aid Cooldown 20s → 15s  

🗺 Stage Adjustments  
 Stage 1 Boss (Goblin King): Damage nerfed.  
 Stage 2 Boss (Minotaur): Damage buffed.  
 Stage 3 Boss (Hydra): Damage buffed & adjusted slow effect.  

⚖ Balance Changes  
 Rebalanced all boss damage for better gameplay fairness.  
 Adjusted Ice Spike slow effect on Stage 3.  
 Buffed Berserker's Blood: Damage reduction -25% → -15%.  
 Buffed Double Edge: Damage reduction -30% → -20%.  
 Buffed Damage upgrades: Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic values 2/4/6/9 → 3/5/7/10.  
 Buffed Uncommon HP & Stamina upgrades: Increased 10 → 15.  
 Buffed Rare Skill Amp upgrade: Increased 10% → 15%.  
 Adjusted stat weighting: Reduced Critical Damage & Stamina weight, increasing the chance for Damage & Attack Speed upgrades.

notes.title: Dev Update - Beta Test Invitation
notes.notes:
After a break and overhauling the entire enemy code and entire stage 3 enemies lineups, we're almost ready to beta test the latest version with new character and stage 3
As to why we did the overhaul is to make future update faster and easier to implement, new enemies system allow us to mix and match enemy attack and adjust the parameter.

Currently the only way to join our beta test is by joining our discord and request ZhangYG for the role.

Our estimation, the beta test will be ready by the end of October
And the test duration will depends on how much bug and adjustment we will make during that time.

After everything clear we will roll out the update for the public as soon as possible

notes.title: Dev Update: Game Release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we from KatrGames are excited to announce that Tiny Chaos will be releasing within this week on 28th March 2024 and we will be giving 20% special discount on the first week of the release.
Also we also will be taking down the demo that has been there since the Steam Next Fest, we sincerly thankful for everyone that has downloaded, played, and wishlisted our game!

Now we will talk about what's new for the released version
First, as per our last announcement we are adding Localization for Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, Germany, and Bahasa Indonesia.
Next, we are adding Stage 2 with the new enemies, mini boss, and of course a new boss monster!
not forgeting the new unlockable character that can be obtained by conquering Hard difficulty.
Then we also add more QoL update, now you can check the taken upgrades from the database that located on the middle of the pause menu, lastly there will be more indicators and more sfx for that is still missing.

Since we are trying new stuff on Stage 2 we would like to ask for your opinion after experiencing the gameplay yourself, feel free to talk to us and discuss stuff!

We will be back again soon to announce more stuff so stay tune and thank you for the support!
